references.text: God's prophecy to Abraham that his descendants would be strangers in a land not their own for 400 years, and that afterward they would come out with great possessions.
Parallel description of the same day when the Lord brought the children of Israel out of Egypt.
Reference to the Lord's command to bring the children of Israel out of Egypt, division by division.
God's prediction that He would lead His armies, His people Israel, out of Egypt.
Stephen's speech referring to God's promise that Abraham's descendants would be strangers for 400 years before being delivered.
Paul refers to the 430 years from the promise to Abraham until the law was given, confirming the time period.
Description of the children of Israel's departure from Egypt under the leadership of Moses and Aaron, organized as divisions.
Direct allusion using the exodus event as a reference point for a new revelation.
